scientific_integrity: The proof uses classical Vivanti-Pringsheim and algebraic singularity transfer, and distinguishes finite coefficient computations from general proof. This is an analytical mathematical result without independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact full pgf-admissibility endpoint in [2/5, theta_*] is unresolved; the exact theta_* classifies eventual coefficient positivity, not positivity in every degree. Conclusions hold for the displayed quadratic zero-truncated-binomial conjugacy and fixed-parameter coefficient asymptotics.
title: A sharp eventual-sign barrier for a quadratic-binomial stopping semigroup
